description: Have a voice agent call a list of people through the platform's own batch: recipients (numbers, or {to, name, variables}, up to 1,000), from, name, scheduledAt (ISO), maxConcurrency (Vapi). Vapi runs it as a campaign, Retell and ElevenLabs as a batch call, Telnyx as one scheduled call each. No credits; the platform bills the calls. In the US the FCC requires prior express written consent for marketing calls made with an AI voice; getting it is the caller’s responsibility. Needs Vapi, Retell AI or ElevenLabs connected (Connectors, or connect_connector with the API key), or Telnyx for its AI Assistants.

provider.description: only when more than one voice platform is connected
